content: Akati ana ku Sindeketa Jesu
Munyima no eyo Jesu sebeli ota mu milenen̄i ni mu mindi yo iyeta Eliywi no kuwaba no mubuso wa Nyambe. Aiyetwa aye no ku kwana likumi na yiili aali naye
nakati ngeeso ana ku balisiwa ku mebo no kwiiba ni ku meeti. Maliya ona kwiisaniwa nji Magadalena woyo ona ku tundisiwa emebo no kwiiba itanu ni yiili (7),
ni Joana omoywa Chuza, esikombwa sa Heloda, ni Suzana, nanjili ngeeso ano kupula, ana ku sebeleza Jesu ni ufumu woo.
Enguli no Mukuni
Cwale oundi no aanu aba ona kumana oukuwana, naanu ana ku tunda mu titolopo tonje sebeli aiya kwa Jesu, sebeli waambela enguli nji,
“Omukuni nakuta muku kuna embuto yaye, mi yo lemine okukuna ngeeso, injili embuto sebeli ikwela mu ndila, mi sebeli ilyatangiwa ni makondo, mi otuyunyi na mu wilu sebeli iilya.
Injili sebeli ikwela ba mawee, eikula sebeli iletuka, kakuli kakwa sikwikala omukamo.
Cwale einjili sebeli ikwela mu mikakani, mi emikakani aba ina kukulelela bamweya sebeli iyowelisa embuto.
Cwale injili mbuto sebeli ikwela mu mumbu no kuwaba niku kula wino ni kubeeka omwaanda no etimbuto.” Yo amba ngeeso, sebeli okuweleza nji, “Woyo oli ni matwi no ku yupisa, ayupe!”
Etuso no Tinguli
Cwale aiyetwa aye aba ana ku mwibanguta etaluso no nguli eyo,
sebeli wamba nji, “Anyi na mubiwi oku limuka etikunutu no mubuso wa Nyambe, kono anjili kame atalusetwa mu tinguli, nji cwale oku mona kame amona kono kayupisisa.
Jesu yo Talusa Enguli no Mukuni
Cwale enguli kame italusa ngeesi nji, embuto eliywi lya Nyambe.
Embuto ina ku kwela mu ndila okame awo ana yupu eliywi, cwale Diyabulosi aba aiya kame atundisa eliywi ana yupu mu micima yoo nji alese oku pumena ni ku yoyisiwa.
Embuto eyo ili ba liwee okame awo, aba amana okuyupa eliywi, kame alitambula mu kuwabelelwa, kono kakwite emibisi mi kame alitambula mu nako icana feela, cwale emiliko aba iiya kame akwa.
Mi kweyo ina kwele mu mikona, okame awo ayupa eliywi, kono aba ata mu ndila yoo kame akeshebiswa ni tipilaelo ni ufumu, ni myelembo no mooyo, mi embuya yoo kayiimbi.
Mi kweyo mbuto ili mu mumbu no kuwaba, okame awo ayupa eliywi ni ku litambula muwangu ni mu ku sepahala ni micima no kuwaba, ni ku beeka embuya mu ku tundamena.
Elambi munji no Siwana
Kakwisa omunu otwesa oku monyeka elambi ni kwifukela munji no siwana, simba okwibeeka munji no mumbeta, kono ibeekiwe ba lutala nji omunu aba aingena amone eliseli.
Kakuli kakwisa eso sishweekiwa eso sasi ulwe oku shootolwa, simba esi sili kuuwi sasi ulwe oku limukiwa ni kwiiya ba liseli.
Cwale mumamele omu muyupela, kakuli woyo okwite eso ali naso, mba beekelwa, kono awo aulwile esinjiili, simba eso apuluka nji kame ali naso mbasi byanguliwa.”
Inawaye Jesu na Inaaye
Cwale inawaye Jesu na inaaye sebeli aiya kwa yonyene, kono kasi ku twesa okukeela ku nyonga yaye, mulibaka no kupula no aanu.
Cwale Jesu sebeli wambeliwa nji, “Inaowe na inoowe kame aimanine bandee, kame ashukele oukumona.”
Kono Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Inawange na inaange okame awo ayupa eliywi lya Nyambe niku libelekisa.”
Jesu yo Ondota Elin̄ungwa
Eliywaa linjili Jesu sebeli okulonga na iyetwa aye mu wato ni kwamba kwa onyene nji, “Tu lutelenyi mu linjaliya no lisa.” Cwale sebeli afuula.
Alemine okuluta ngeeso, Jesu sebeli olangana okutela ba tulo. Cwale emebo no lin̄ungwa sebeli iinguka ba lisa, mane sebeli asinga okutika ku meyi mi kame ana kwikala mu utata no kuneneba.
Aiyetwa sebeli ata kwa Jesu oka mwingula aamba nji, “Molyetu, Molyetu! kame tufa!” Mi Jesu sebeli oinguka ni ku kalimela elin̄ungwa ni mandinda, mi sebeli iimana ni kondoka tuu.

Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa iyetwa aye nji, “Etumelo yenu ibine?” Mi sebeli acila ni ku komoka nuukwambisa omunjili ku munjili nji, “Anyine cwale wuyu mulume? Nji mane kame alaela emebo ni meyi, mi kame imukuteka!”
Jesu yo Balisa Omulume no Mebo no Kwiiba
Cwale Jesu na iyetwa aye sebeli aka fuweka mu naha no Magelasenesi, eyo ikubapile ni Galileya.

Cwale Jesu yosi longoka feela okuta ba likamba, sebeli okwangana ni mulume ona ku tunda mu mulenen̄i osi mebo no kwiiba, ba nako no kuleba kasi kumanganga eikumango mane kasi ku yoyanga mu ndoo, kono mu mayumbelo.

Cwale omulume woyo aba ana kumona Jesu, sebeli okuweleza ni liywi no kuneneba ni ku mukubamena balubala lwaye ni kwamba niliywi linene nji, “Iikene osaela oku tenda ni mene, Jesu Mwana Nyambe OMWAMBAKANI oli beulu? Kame niku kumbela, olese oku ni yandisa!”

Kakuli Jesu kame ana ku laela emebo no kwiiba oku tunda mwa woyo mulume. Kakuli mu tinako no kupula kame ina ku katazanga onene, mane kame ana ku babalelwangwa yo nungilwe ni tungongolo, ni yoondo ku makondo, kono kame ana kucola otungongolo, mi emebo no kwiiba sebeli imu twala mu lihalaupa.
Jesu cwale sebeli omwibanguta nji, “Tiwe anyine elitina?” Mi sebeli otambula nji, “Time empi,’” kakuli emebo no kupula no kwiiba kame ina ku mwingena.
Cwale emebo no kwiiba sebeli ikumbela Jesu nji alese okwilaela nji ite mu wina.
Cwale omulaka no kuneneba no angulube kame ona ku lyelanga ba lilundu, mi cwale emebo no kwiiba sebeli ikumbela Jesu nji iingene mu tingulube, sebeli oipumenena okaingenamo.
Cwale emebo no kwiiba sebeli itunda ku mulume nukaingena mu tingulube, mi omulaka sebeli witukela mu lin̄ope no lisa ni ku mina ameyi.
Cwale aanu aba ana kumona eyo ina tendahala, sebeli acila nuukabiha etaba eyo mu mulenen̄i ni mu naha.

Cwale aanu sebeli ata oka mona eyo ina tendahala, mi sebeli aiya kwa Jesu nuukawana omulume ona ku tundisiwa emebo no kwiiba yo ikalile ba makondo a Jesu, yo ku fukile yo ku ketile wino ni tingana taye, cwale sebeli acila.
Cwale awo ana ku mona eyo sebeli aambela aanu omu ana ku yandisetwa ku mebo no kwiiba nomo ana balisetwe.
Cwale aanu onje na mu manyonga no naha no Magelesani sebeli akumbela Jesu nji aasiye kakuli kame ana ku lemiwa ku kucila onene, mi sebeli oingena mu wato ni kuuka.
Omulume woyo ona ku tundisiwa emebo no kwiiba sebeli okumbela Jesu nji ate naye, Kono Jesu sebeli omulukulula nji akutele ni ku mwamba nji,
“Ouke ku mundi wowe, mi okaambe einu no kuneneba ana tende Nyambe kwa wene.” Mi woyo mulume sebeli okutela okaamba eyo inene ana tendelwe kwa Jesu mu mulenen̄i monje.
Omwana Jailosi no Mukatana ni mukati ona ku Lema Jesu ku Mukanjo
Cwale Jesu aba ana kuuka, oundi no aanu sebeli omu tambula, kakuli onje kame ana ku mu tatelela.
Cwale sebeli kwiiya omulume no litina lya Jailasi, omwendisi no ndoo no milapelo, ni ku kwela ku makondo a Jesu, mi sebeli omu kumbela nji ate ku ndoo yaye,
kakuli kame ana kwikalanga ni mwana mumweya no mukatana, osi myaka likumi ni yiili, mi kame ana kwiikala beebi ni kufa. Cwale Jesu yo seenda, aanu sebeli amuumbelela.
Cwale omukati ona ku tomanga oweeti no mweeya mu myaka likumi ni yiili, kasi ku twesahala oku balisiwa ku munu,
sebeli wiiya munyima ya Jesu, ni kulema ku mungundo no mukanjo waye, mi ababo sebeli obala ku weeti waye no mweeya.
Cwale Jesu sebeli oibanguta nji, “Anyini ona nileme?” Cwale aanu onje sebeli akana, mi Pitolosi sebeli wamba nji, “Molyange, oundi no aanu akuumbelele, mi kame aku sinanisa.”
Kono Jesu sebeli wamba nji, “Omunjili nani leme, kakuli kame ni lemuha nji amaata anjili naabu mwa mene.”
Cwale omukati abana kumona nji katwese oukushweeka, sebeli oiya kwa Jesu yo cilile, ni ku mukubamena ni kwamba balubala no aanu eso ana ku mulemena noomo ana balele muwangu-wangu.
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Mwanange, etumelo yowe naiku yoyisa. Ote mu kozo.”
Jesu yo saamba, sebeli kwiiya omulume ona ku tundelela ku ndoo no mwendisi ni kwamba nji, “Mwanowe nafu, olese oku kataza Omwiyeti.”
Kono Jesu aba ana kuyupa ngeeso, sebeli wambela Jailosi nji, “Olese ku cila, opumene feela, mi mwanowe mba yoyisiwa.”
Cwale aba ana ku keela ku ndoo, kasi ku pumenena omunu okwingena mu ndoo, konji Pitolosi, ni Jowani, ni Jakobo, sitaye ni inawaye omwanukana.
Cwale onje aanu kame anaku lilanga ni ku musilisa, kono Jesu sebeli waambela nji, “Mulese kulila, omwanukana kasifa, kono kame alanganine feela!”
Cwale onje sebeli asheka Jesu, muku limuka nji omwanukana nafu.
Jesu sebeli omulema ku lyooko ni ku mwisana nji, “Mwanukana, inguka!”
Cwale emebo yaye sebeli yukela mwa yonyene, mi ababo omwanukana sebeli oinguka, cwale Jesu sebeli olaela nji omwanukana alukisetwe esi no kulya nji alye.
Cwale ashemi aye sebeli akomoka, kono Jesu sebeli waalaelela nji alese okwambela omunu eyo ina tendahala.
